exercises.explanationUz:
13-14-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  KO'ChIRMA GAP: asked me WHERE I
    lived; she SAID to me; He asked
    IF I knew Steve
  BAYRAM/KONSERT: the best party
    I've EVER been to; How OFTEN?;
    INTERESTED in coming; not later
    THAN five; MAKE a speech;
    can't WAIT to go; won't be able
    to MAKE it; couldn't BELIEVE
    it; What was it LIKE?; went AS
    a pilot; can't STAND listening;
    looking FORWARD to
  YO'L KO'RSATISh: TAKE the first
    turning; ON your left
  Boshqa: ready FOR your test;
    give me a HAND; protect himself
    FROM the sun


⚠ 'TO MAKE IT':

  = yetib bormoq, ulgurmoq.


⚠ 'A FANCY-DRESS PARTY':

  = kostyumli ziyofat.

exercises.explanationUz:
13-14-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  -ING / TO:
  1 Stop TALKING (to'xtatmoq)
  2 couldn't HELP laughing =
    kulmasdan turolmadim
  3 Remember TO TAKE (eslab qilmoq)
  5 can't stand LISTENING
  LUG'AT:
  4 facing EXTINCTION = yo'q bo'lib
    ketish xavfida
  6 Stop BLOWING your whistle =
    hushtak chalish
  7 BRING you good luck = omad
    keltiradi
  8 had never seen a tiger BEFORE
  9 he TOLD me (told + kim)
  10 WAVING a flag = bayroq
    silkitish


⚠ 'REMEMBER TO' va 'REMEMBER -ING':

  remember TO take = olishni
  unutma; remember takING =
  olganini eslamoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
YO'L SO'RASh, TADBIR, TAKLIF
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 'Yes, there is' → IS THERE A
    supermarket near here?
  2 'It was great' → HOW WAS the
    party?
  3 'Over three thousand people' →
    HOW MANY PEOPLE WERE THERE at
    the concert?
  4 'OK. What time?' → WOULD YOU
    LIKE / DO YOU WANT to come to
    the circus?
  5 'I love playing basketball' →
    WHAT DO YOU LIKE doing in your
    free time?


⚠ 'OVER THREE THOUSAND':

  = uch mingdan ortiq.

tasks.prompt: A: Excuse me. ___ supermarket near here?  B: Yes, there is. It's in Green Street.
tasks.speak: A: Excuse me. ___ supermarket near here?  B: Yes, there is. It's in Green Street.

tasks.prompt: A: ___ the party?  B: It was great.
tasks.speak: A: ___ the party?  B: It was great.

tasks.prompt: A: ___ at the rock concert?  B: Over three thousand people.
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ Son javobi → 'How many people were there?'
tasks.speak: A: ___ at the rock concert?  B: Over three thousand people.

tasks.prompt: A: ___ to come to the circus? It'll be fun.  B: OK. What time?
tasks.speak: A: ___ to come to the circus? It'll be fun.  B: OK. What time?

tasks.prompt: A: ___ doing in your free time?  B: Well, I love playing basketball.
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ 'What do you like doing?' → 'I love playing ...'
tasks.speak: A: ___ doing in your free time?  B: Well, I love playing basketball.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + asked (me) + where/if + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She asked me where I lived. He asked if I knew Steve.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mendan qayerda yashashimni so'radi. U Stivni bilaman-yo'qmi deb so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: stop / can't stand / couldn't help + V-ing;  remember + to V
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Stop talking. I can't stand listening to pop music. Remember to take a jacket.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Gapirishni bas qiling. Pop musiqa tinglashga chiday olmayman. Kurtka olishni unutma.

sentencePatterns.formula: Go down X Street and take the first turning on your left.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Go down Green Street and take the first turning on your left.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Grin ko'chasi bo'ylab boring va chapdagi birinchi burilishga kiring.

sentencePatterns.formula: It was the best ... I've ever + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It was the best party I've ever been to.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu men borgan eng yaxshi ziyofat edi.
